FocalDocument.Title: Policy and Procedures
FocalDocument.Description: The organization develops, documents, and disseminates access control policy and procedures.

ReferencedDocument.Title: Policies for Information Security
ReferencedDocument.Description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, and published.

FocalDocument.Title: Account Management
FocalDocument.Description: The organization manages information system accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, reviewing, disabling, and removing accounts.

ReferencedDocument.Title: Access Control
ReferencedDocument.Description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented.

FocalDocument.Title: Access Enforcement
FocalDocument.Description: The information system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

ReferencedDocument.Title: Privileged Access Rights
ReferencedDocument.Description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

FocalDocument.Title: Event Logging
FocalDocument.Description: The information system identifies and records audited events according to organizational audit policy.

ReferencedDocument.Title: Logging
ReferencedDocument.Description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.
